snippet.title: FEEDSTOCK - Co-op Horror Where Your Loot Eats You | Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
FEEDSTOCK is a 4-player co-op horror game. Your loot doesn't go in a
backpack - it goes into Tally, and she grows.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5154830/FEEDSTOCK/?beta=1
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/Ebn6XEPa2F

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT IS FEEDSTOCK?

Four of you break into a house and strip it room by room. Furniture,
wiring, whatever isn't nailed down. But there's no inventory - everything
you take goes straight into Tally, and every item makes her bigger.

Feed her too little and she starts eating the crew.
Feed her too much and she won't fit back through the door you came in.

The house is different every run. So is what's living in it.

FEATURES

- Co-op horror for up to 4 players
- Proximity voice chat - your friends hear you panic
- Procedurally generated houses
- A monster that physically grows as you feed her
- Creatures that hunt you while you work

RELEASE

Playable demo coming for Steam Next Fest, October 19-26.
Full release October 29, 2026.

If you like Lethal Company, R.E.P.O., Content Warning or PEAK -
this co-op horror game is for you.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
